summary: A satirical piece mocking a wave of quirky community health initiatives aimed at teenagers in a health-obsessed city. It walks through eight programs from September 2023 to March 2024, including avocado toast bars, a smoothie contest, a donut-chased race, a sleep competition, a vegetable-eating video game, weightlifting therapy, breathwork with kale lasagna, and a quinoa ball scavenger hunt. It closes by suggesting the programs may mostly be sharpening teens' irony and delivering laughter.
one_line: Satirical roundup of eight absurd youth health programs from late 2023 to March 2024, from avocado toast bars to a quinoa ball scavenger hunt.
key_facts: Since October 5, 2023, the Lighthearted Avocado Movement (LAM), spearheaded by health guru Bonnie Greenleaf, has run pop-up avocado toast bars in high schools where students pledge to replace fried snacks.

On September 18, 2023, the first annual "Drink Your Greens and Grin" competition was broadcast live on Metropolis Youth Radio, with teens distinguishing green smoothies from less appealing green liquids.
Chuck Kaleman was the master of ceremonies for "Drink Your Greens and Grin"; the note says that is not his real last name.
16-year-old Molly Meadow won "Drink Your Greens and Grin" and received a year's supply of green smoothie.

The "Sprint to Your Prime" race on September 24, 2023, was organized by Geoff Sprintsberg, an ex-track celebrity turned health coach, and had each participant chased by a giant inflatable rolling donut.
The "Snoozefest Championship" launched November 1, 2023, by health teachers Pam Pillow and Matt Matress, was a sleep-off in a school gymnasium with techno beats and strobe lights.
The Snoozefest champion won a lifetime supply of chamomile tea bags and the title "Master of the Mattress".

On December 8, 2023, Cy Berger created the Virtual Veggie Challenge, an online gaming arena where teens power up avatars by eating real vegetables on webcam; spinach gave strength boosts and carrots gave agility upgrades.
Sister Swole (Brenda Biceps) started "Benchpress Your Worries" on January 15, 2024, having teens write fears on paper weights and lift them.
Brenda Biceps said: "It's not just about building muscles; it's about lifting the weight off their chest."
Barry Breathwork introduced the "Breathe Your Way to Bliss" workshop on February 14, 2024, teaching breathing techniques followed by a communal kale lasagna meal.
Quincy Quinoa launched the "Quinoa Ball Quest" on March 22, 2024, a scavenger hunt for hidden quinoa balls where students posted selfies with the hashtag #GreatBallsOfHealth.
